planets.name: TOI-216 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-216 with a 17.4-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: TOI-216 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-216. Its orbit and size follow Dawson et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
